sec.t: KB Kabira Skincare Open Pore Face Wash (100ml)
p: Reveal smoother, healthier-looking skin with KB Kabira Skincare Open Pore Barrier Repair & Pore Minimizing Face Wash. Specially formulated to target enlarged pores and restore the skin barrier, this gentle yet effective cleanser deeply purifies the skin while maintaining essential moisture.

Infused with powerful skincare ingredients like Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide, Ceramides, and Cica Extract, this face wash helps unclog pores, control excess oil, and soothe irritated or dry skin. The advanced formula works to minimize the appearance of open pores while strengthening the skin barrier for a clearer, more balanced complexion.
Its lightweight, skin-friendly formula removes dirt, impurities, and excess sebum without over-drying, leaving your skin feeling refreshed, calm, and visibly smoother after every wash.
Suitable For:All skin types, especially oily, combination, and pore-prone skin.
How to Use:Apply a small amount to damp skin, gently massage in circular motions, and rinse thoroughly with water. Use twice daily for best results.
li: Helps minimize the appearance of enlarged pores
Deeply cleanses and removes excess oil and impurities
Calms dry, irritated, and sensitive skin
Strengthens and repairs the skin barrier
Enriched with Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide, Ceramides & Cica Extract
